notation: Contexts are where a component may be placed. A container tag establishes its context. allowedIn edges name supported contexts; they do not pass density or size down (only the size attribute does that).

page.summary: Top level: region padding plus a centered 72rem max width.

region.summary: A major area of a page (8u padding, square).

panel.summary: A side or tool panel (6u padding, square).

tile.summary: A small card in a grid (3u padding).

collection.summary: A list or set of like items (2u padding).

form.summary: Inside a <form>: form-associated components submit, reset and validate with it.

inline.summary: Running text or any flow content.

nesting.rule: Nest outer to inner in this order; a level may be skipped. Inner radius never exceeds the outer level's (resolveContainer caps it).

forbidden.rule: No interactive control inside ui-button, ui-chip or ui-option.
forbidden.reason: Nested interactive content has no accessible name or focus model; the chip remove icon is a click target, not a control.

forbidden.rule: No native form elements inside any ui-* component.
forbidden.reason: Form participation goes through UIFormElement; tests enforce it.

forbidden.rule: ui-option only as a direct child of ui-listbox, ui-segmented or ui-select.
forbidden.reason: The owning list sets role, id and selection state.

forbidden.rule: ui-swatch selection only inside ui-palette with name or selectable.
forbidden.reason: The palette owns the listbox role and value.
